Kokō no hana to yobareru Eikoku bishōjo, gimai ni nattara bukiyō ni amaete kita
孤高の華と呼ばれる英国美少女、義妹になったら不器用に甘えてきた

80759.synopsis:
Lin Yue, transmigrated into the 1980s, and became a stepmother to two children. Watch how this bear overcomes challenge after challenge, despite her large frame and blindness in one eye!
Daughter: “He bullied me.”
Lin Yue: “Memorize the human anatomy chart, avoid vital organs and blood vessels in fights, even if you get slashed dozens of times, it’s just minor injuries.”
Son: “He hit me.”
Lin Yue: “Remember the compensation list for body parts, see how much pocket money you get, then hit back accordingly, so you won’t have to pay if you don’t have money.”
Xia Qing Shan, whose company is growing bigger and bigger: “Wife, the house is yours, the children are yours, the savings are yours. I also belong to you!”
Lin Yue: “Get lost, I have both children and a career. What do I need you for? Are you here to be a decoration?”
Xia Qing Shan: “No, I’m useful too. Don’t believe me? Give it a try…”
associated_names: 重生八零我成了两个孩子的后妈

81527.synopsis:
“I love a woman other than you. So break off the engagement with me, Reubellina.”
For ten years, Reubellina has stood by the side of the powerless Second Prince.
But her love was cruelly trampled on the day of their supposed wedding announcement.
Worse, this shameful incident was discovered by someone.
Tartenon Speraum, the Iron-Blooded Grand Duke of the North!
Reubellina begs him to keep it a secret, but he offers her one condition.
A 3-year contract marriage.
And so she went to the North, cultivated the barren land, fixed the chaotic internal affairs, and dealt with the corrupt nobles.
She did everything she could. She thought all she just had to do was leave now.
“Divorce? I don’t know what you’re talking about. Our contract period is not over yet.”
“There’s one day left. I wanted to tell you in advance… … .”
“I’m sorry, Reubellina. I had no intention of letting you go. From the beginning.”
[What? Did I hear wrong?]
“Don’t even think about running away. You’re already mine.”
[Excuse me, Grand Duke. Why are you obsessed with me?]

82295.synopsis:
Gu Xingyou transmigrated into a novel filled with deep, tragic love and a broken mirror being mended. He became the second male lead, who was first used by the drunken main character (seme) as a stand-in for his ex-boyfriend and later added fuel to the fire of the protagonists’ love, ultimately ending up wandering far away.
Gu Xingyou: Wandering far away is not an option; is it really that hard to be a laid-back person? Living one more day is one more day.
Later, he realized that he wasn’t even qualified to be a laid-back person; only by diligently protecting the main character’s (seme’s) life could he survive—and as he protected him, he gradually rose to the top.
＊
When Gu Xingyou first met Ji Chen, he was cold and proud, like a hedgehog full of spikes. Only when Gu Xingyou truly got close to him did he discover that the hedgehog was a facade; inside, he was soft and sweet, making it impossible to resist.
Gu Xingyou × Ji Chen

83063.synopsis:
Chen Luo discovered he could scavenge the minds of the dead.
So he went to a graveyard and scavenge the brain of a deceased Great Emperor, figuring he’d borrow it for a bit.
While others were still fretting over how to cultivate Qi and achieve Foundation Establishment, Chen Luo was already pondering the ninety-ninth method for reaching the Mahayana stage.

83319.synopsis:
On her way home, Ye Xin is stopped by a beautiful little kitten. The kitten, with its tortoiseshell fur and sapphire blue eyes, instantly captures Ye Xin’s heart. She decides to take it home. However, she soon discovers that the kitten is not just a pretty face. It has a cold personality, a bad temper, and refuses to be petted or held. It won’t eat cat food or canned food, and constantly steals Ye Xin’s snacks. As a result, Ye Xin gives up takeout and develops the habit of cooking at home every day. Despite its many bad habits, the kitten always sneaks into Ye Xin’s bed at night. What can she do but forgive it?
One morning, Ye Xin is awakened by strange movements in her bed and finds a beautiful woman lying in her arms. This woman is none other than Bai Xiyin, her arch-nemesis at work who has always competed with her for resources and positions. Bai Xiyin, still half-asleep, naturally snuggles into Ye Xin’s arms and asks, ‘You’re awake? Not going back to sleep?’ Her voice is soft and husky, and she nuzzles Ye Xin’s chin just like the kitten.

85879.synopsis:
The Grand Wizard Jesquière, who lived eternally as the owner of the Magic Tower.
That’s his second chance at life given to him.
An idol? That’s just a trivial thing.
Just breathing alone can make you an idol.
Since I’m already a grand wizard, it’s already decided that I’ll be at top.

87415.synopsis:
A chance opportunity to film a MV brought Jiang Liusui into contact with one of the entertainment world’s top-tier stars. He Yujing, was a prodigy who rose to fame young and hails from an influential family. Wherever he goes, he was showered with admiration.
To Jiang Liusui, He Yujing was a friend, an older brother who looked out for him—until He Yujing confessed his feelings. 
Although his emotions were in turmoil, Jiang Liusui still turned him down.
Jiang Liusui’s rapid rise to fame made him an obstacle in other people’s way. Overnight, a flood of fabricated scandals came crashing down on him. Jiang Liusui’s reputation was in ruins, and even his company wanted to abandon him.
It was at this moment that the man he had recently rejected extended a hand to him.
“I can help you, but there is one condition.”
Jiang Liusui asked in a low voice, “What condition?”
He Yujing fixed his gaze on him, his eyes dark and heavy.
Since Jiang Liusui did not want to begin a romantic relationship, He Yujing would find another way to entangle themselves.
He Yujing said unhurriedly, “Be my lover.”
If Jiang Liusui said no, He Yujing would still continue helping him in secret—consider it as the last gift he’d ever give him.
But if Jiang Liusui agreed, then no matter what happened in the future, He Yujing would never let him go.
Once he accepted the deal, Jiang Liusui moved into He Yujing’s house.
Although he vaguely sensed that his relationship with He Yujing was different from a typical “lover” arrangement, Jiang Liusui temporarily treated what existed between them as a transaction and did not think too deeply about He Yujing’s intentions.
At a social gathering, a friend saw He Yujing had brought someone along, and it was clear their relationship was anything but ordinary. Teasingly, the friend asked, “A’Jing, aren’t you going to introduce him?”
Jiang Liusui suddenly felt a weight settle on his shoulder as someone wrapped an arm around him.
He Yujing smiled and said, “This is my boyfriend.”
***
The shou thought he was just a “lover”, but the gong regarded him as his boyfriend.

88439.synopsis:
Wang Sasa inexplicably transmigrated into a book and somehow ended up wooing the supporting female character, Tan Yixuan, who at first seemed like a delicate white lotus.
Later, she realized that Tan Yixuan was anything but a white lotus.
She was clearly a man-eating flower that doesn’t spit out the bones!
The ‘man-eating flower’ wasn’t even human, and she was both cunning and possessive. She grabbed Wang Sasa by the neck and tearfully begged, “Please don’t leave me, okay?”
Feeling the grip on her neck, Wang Sasa reluctantly agreed, “Alright, alright! Fine, fine! Just let go! Everything can be negotiated!!”
In short: To Tan Yixuan, this story is about unrequited love. For Wang Sasa, it’s just about flirting with a cute girl on her way home.
A self-absorbed, drama-loving bottom vs. a yandere, scheming top.
associated_names: 白切黑女配偏爱我[穿书]

88695.synopsis:
“After Hyung disappeared, he was erased from everyone’s memory.”
68 years ago, Kim Shibaek crash-landed in the otherworldly realm of ‘Mach Slecht’ and suddenly found himself returning to Korea. 
Upon his return, he is reunited with a younger brother, Taewoon, whom he had cherished as a child.
For Shibaek, only 21 years had passed on Earth since his disappearance. 
However, during that time, the world was overrun by monsters, and people began awakening supernatural abilities.
Among the most famous of these awakened hunters is Taewoon, an S-rank hunter and the notorious leader of the Seven Guild, known for his bad-tempered and eccentric personality.
“Why does he look so worn out…? My little Woonie used to smell like sunshine when he stood still and like milk when he toddled around. His chubby cheeks were so soft and plump, and he was so small and cute….”
But Taewoon, who is still adorable in Shibaek’s eyes, tells him a shocking truth before Shibaek can even adjust to life on Earth: Taewoon is the only one who remembers Shibaek, even though he was once an Olympic gold medalist.
While searching for a way to return to Mach Slecht, a system window suddenly appears before Shibaek, throwing him into a series of critical quests.
[Say ‘I love you’ to a living being.] 
[Oh, and by the way! If you fail or refuse to complete the quest, Earth will be destroyed.] 
However, Shibaek hesitates to complete the quest, and the system informs him that only by preventing Earth’s destruction will he discover how to return to Mach Slecht…?
associated_names: The Mad Dog's First Love Has Returned

89975.synopsis:
An alien creature disguised as a boy handling various human messes in everyday life +
It’s an alien creature that survives through parasitism, having gone through great suffering. After being forcibly expelled, it unexpectedly parasitizes the brain-dead body of a boy named Yan Zhen.
This is a warm and cozy host body, and the key is: it’s alive!
To fulfill this boy’s wish, Yan Zhen begins his law-abiding life of pretending to be human. +
Reading Guide: A lighthearted story of an inhuman male protagonist with a cat and a chicken. This story alternates between calm everyday life and strange, extraordinary events.
Tags: Sci-fi, Freaky Incidents, School Life, Lighthearted
Protagonist: Yan Zhen; Supporting characters: Mr. Cat, Liu Xingquan, Luo Qingxi, Captain Ban
Others: Love and Hope
One-sentence summary: The goofy daily life of an alien creature pretending to be a boy on Earth.
Theme: Through the eyes of an alien creature, witness various aspects of human life, taste the mixed emotions of people, and feel their longing for beautiful things. The story promotes positive friendships, teacher-student relationships, and family bonds.

91511.synopsis:
The Empress Dowager sent me to secretly investigate whether the new emperor had any hidden ailments. 
However, due to one careless mistake, I ended up being completely devoured by the dog emperor.
So, with my back aching and gritting my teeth under the emperor’s dark gaze, I reported to the Empress Dowager: 
“Your Majesty is quite… straight. He was straight all night long.”
Later, one day, the new emperor held my waist thoughtfully and remarked, “Imperial Scholar, it seems you’ve gained some weight.”
Gritting my teeth, I thought: Of course! How could I not?
…Thanks to you, I’m now running away with your child.
associated_names: 朕的探花郎又雙叒叕帶球跑了

91767.synopsis:
In the year 2222 AD, Earth was shielded by the stars.
Losing the sun, stopping its operation, a global extinction crisis.
The only chance for Terrans is Pandora’s Box.
Participate in the game within the box, find the lost item within, and redeem Earth.
Thus, the Terrans went mad. 
—————————————————
Ning Buwen, possessed by the spirit of a drama queen and loving money as much as his life, opened his own Pandora’s Box.
Received his own newbie gift pack — a Shiba Inu.
Starting with a dog, passing levels by howling.
Faced with such a bleak reality, Ning Buwen established his own life goal here.
“When I redeem Earth, I’ll make all Terrans pay me ransom!”
“The next global richest person will be me!”

92023.synopsis: I have a strange illness. Whenever I see my roommate Lin Yu Fei, I have an episode . I have a bizarre condition where I start lactating just from seeing my roommate Lin Yu Fei. After secretly moving out of the dormitory, my condition improved. Just when I thought I was about to recover, I was cornered by Lin Yu Fei, who had returned to the country early. He buried his head in my arms. ‘What are you trying to cure? I like it very much.’

92535.synopsis:
Izumi is summoned to another world as one among six new Heroes to supposedly combat an impending calamity — but one of the other Heroes, Haruka, senses the suspicious atmosphere of the summoning ritual and convinces her to secretly escape from the royal castle using their newfound cheat-like abilities.
While gathering information, they discover they can’t return to Earth — and so they decide, why not find a peaceful place to settle down and live a carefree life?
Changing their names to Ize and Hal, and drawn by the prospects of local gourmet food and the breathtaking landscapes of this new world, the odd duo of junior highschooler and de-aged corporate manager set out on their sightseeing adventure!
associated_names: Toubou Kenja (Kouho) no Burari Tabi ~Shoukan Saremashitaga, Nigedashite Annei no Chisagashi wo Tanoshimimasu~
逃亡賢者（候補）のぶらり旅　〜召喚されましたが、逃げ出して安寧の地探しを楽しみます〜

93559.synopsis:
Ruan Hao has transmigrated. 
And she has transmigrated into a dog-blooded novel as the white lotus fiancee of the female lead’s father who dies early on in the novel. A villainess who is entrusted with taking care of the female lead due to the dead father’s will, and according to the will she will receive 50 million yuan once the female lead becomes an adult. 
Ruan Hao: Can such a good thing be true? 
She originally wanted to steadily raise the little puppy and then run away with the money as soon as she became an adult, but then she found a bunch of books on the female lead’s desk—-
《The Thirty-Six Stratagems for Fighting Stepmothers》
《How to force the Temptress to leave the Marriage with Nothing》
《100 Ways to Return to being Straight after being Bent》
Ruan Hao: ???? There seems to be a weird book mixed in?
=========================================
Yan Ning grew up in a rich and powerful family. Relying on her father’s money and her own abilities, she stirred up all sorts of trouble in school. In the end, she became an orphan at seventeen. 
Her father had asked the vixen, the one who wanted to kill her to get to the family property, to….take care of her. 
In the beginning: 
Yan Ning: You vixen, there is no way we can coexist, either you die or I live! Don’t provoke me or you won’t like the consequences! 
Later, Yan Ning blocked the evil vixen at the door of the house and said the most spineless words with the harshest tone: “Be my girlfriend, I beg of you!” 
The vixen Ruan Hao: …..The direction of this novel doesn’t seem quite right. 
Author’s Notes: 
The age difference is 6 years!
No sweetness = no money! 
Pretending to be pure but is a black belly X cute heartthrob CEO
–Wherever you are is where I belong. 
#A totally normal love story where one party thinks the other party is trying to kill you#
#Ruan Hao never had a relationship with the female lead’s father#
#Both characters are adults when they confirm their relationship. No blood relation or legal kinship.#
associated_names: 穿成白莲花女配和女主he了

95607.synopsis:
After two weeks of intense work, Lu Heng collapsed and died suddenly in his apartment.
When he opened his eyes again, he found himself cornered by a group of teenagers, surrounded by unpleasant odors.
One of them smugly reached out to touch Lu Heng’s face.
Lu Heng also raised his hand and punched the other’s jaw.
Jiang Yunxing transmigrated into the ABO novel he had just finished reading, becoming the story’s protagonist gong.
At this moment, the protagonist shou was supposed to be watching the second male lead confront the villain, and Jiang Yunxing was meant to rush over and take the protagonist shou away from the second male lead.
Without hesitation, Jiang Yunxing hurried over with suppressants, only to witness a scene completely different from the original plot.
The bullying second male lead Alpha lay sprawled on the ground, with the supposedly bullied villain Omega stepping on his stomach with his worn sneakers.
Jiang Yunxing: “…” This development seemed off.
When the Omega looked his way, Jiang Yunxing timidly offered the suppressants.
The Omega gave him a cold look before grabbing his collar. “You’re too young to be messing around. Think drugs are something you should touch?”
Jiang Yunxing: “…”
One look confirmed it: they were both transmigrators.
Later, Jiang Yunxing sat in the backseat of eighteen-year-old Lu Heng’s luxury car, listening to him negotiate with a company chairman over the phone, questioning his reality.
Wasn’t this supposed to be a young adult campus redemption story?!

100471.synopsis:
In this life, I won’t be a graduate student; I’ll only study magic.
…Ah, I said I’m not going to be a graduate student!

100727.synopsis:
Wei Jiajia opened her eyes and found herself in the early 1950s, just after the People’s Republic of China was founded. She blinked her bright eyes, pinched herself hard—yes, it was real… The original owner fainted from shock after losing both parents in an accident, and when she woke up, Wei Jiajia had taken her place… Looking at her caring family and finally experiencing the affection she had longed for, her guilty heart stirred! In this era where survival depended on connections, and with an imminent famine approaching, she glanced at her children at home and turned to look at her future husband behind her. Wei Jiajia: “I feel like crying…”
Male lead: Qiao Haoyu had known since childhood about his arranged marriage, but he had always been indifferent about it. He thought if he didn’t find someone he liked, marrying her wouldn’t be a bad idea, especially since his mother approved! But upon seeing Wei Jiajia for the first time, he understood what it meant to fall in love at first sight. “It’s so fragrant…”

105335.synopsis:
Justin, a member of the Landval Kingdom Knights, held the title of Holy Knight and was considered a promising candidate for the next Knight Commander. However, his rival and fellow knight, Hank, framed him for embezzling operational funds, leading to Justin’s demotion to a rural post.
While initially aiming to return to his duties in the Capital, Justin found himself completely charmed by the peaceful and leisurely countryside life. He began to think, “Maybe staying here isn’t so bad after all…” But just as he started to settle in, his junior knight, Elina, from a prestigious family and the very person Hank had been pursuing, unexpectedly followed him to the same rural town for her assignment!
Meanwhile, within the Knights Order, suspicions arose that Justin’s framing might have been orchestrated by someone with ulterior motives…
associated_names: 地方勤務の聖騎士　～王都勤務から農村に飛ばされたので畑を耕したり動物の世話をしながらのんびり仕事します～

105847.synopsis:
As a well-known paparazzo in the industry who mastered all kinds of marketing tricks, Luka was always where the juiciest scandals were.
365 days a year, the gossip never repeated.
Finally, one day, even the heavens couldn’t stand it anymore—so a bolt of lightning struck him into another world.
After transmigrating, his mother was a saint, and his father was the Demon King of Hell.
As the undeniable proof of their disgraceful union, Luka was neither loved by his father nor cared for by his mother. From birth, he was unable to connect with either light or dark elements and was ultimately abandoned in the Land of Exile.
After three days of gnawing on tree bark, unable to survive any longer, Luka decided to return to his old profession—becoming a god of faith.
Marketing, hype, brainwashing! He would gain his own followers and use the power of faith to rise to the top.
Marketing in the Holy Demon Continent would get him beaten? No problem—
A novel titled The Three-Year-Old Beloved took the world by storm. As soon as it was serialized, the readers of the Holy Demon Continent—who had never seen such absurd plots—were furious.
“tr*sh, absolute tr*sh!”
But among the dragon race, where offspring were rare:
“The little cub is too cute!!!“
“Author, please update 30,000 more chapters… What? Someone wants to ban this book, calling it tr*sh?! Anyone who dares to insult our cub is an enemy of the dragon race!“
Mocked for writing niche “found family” stories? No worries—
My Demon King Father, My Saintly Mother, My Wandering Diary, My Heartless Dad, Rebellious Mom, and Broken Self…
One after another, the strongest figures secretly sought out copies. The collector’s edition box set sold out within an hour of release!
What? The demon race issued a wanted notice?
Luka continued writing while also producing films funded by the dragons. With careful planning, a month later, The Fake and Real Young Masters of the Aristocracy premiered.
At the climax, the suffering true heir fell into the sea, and his family was left in regret. Just as the most intense moment arrived, the screen went dark—
“The Fake and Real Young Masters of the Aristocracy: Part One has concluded!”
The demons, known for their thirst for blood and vengeance, had never suffered such torment before.
In an instant, the entire Dark City erupted in chaos.
“What kind of garbage is this?! Get revenge on the continent already!!“
“I’m going to kill the director—no, wait, I need to see the next part first!“
In the entertainment-starved Holy Demon Continent, Luka flourished, from novels to movies, from music to fine arts, ultimately conquering the entire artistic field!
Dragons: “In him, I see the shadow of our cub. Yes. He’s not even twenty yet—definitely an infant by dragon standards!“
Elven King: “Luka is my dearest friend. His music purifies the soul.“
Dwarves (secretly funding him): “Luka’s God of Forging should go down in history! Never before has anyone dared to make a dwarf the main character of a story.“
…
Later, in his memoirs, Luka wrote: I achieved immortality thanks to my rabid, obsessive fans.
Oh, and I also had one terrifying diehard fan…
We got married in the end.

107383.synopsis:
“Your brother borrowed three thousand, just the principal, and the cremation cost five hundred today. How are you going to pay it back?”
“P-please, not my eyes… C-can’t you just… take one… one of my kidneys…?”
“No. Why would I?”
Baek Pilsung, the top gangster, lived a smooth-sailing life, fearing nothing. That is, until he met Nam Wooyoon, a ridiculously naive, insignificant, and adorably cute guy.
Pilsung, visiting the deceased debtor’s body, falls in love at first sight with the terrified Wooyoon. He then devotes himself to winning Wooyoon over.
“…I didn’t buy you this, did I? You said you didn’t have a phone.”
“…Ugh, please spare me…”
“Who the f*ck said I was going to kill you?”
“I’m… sorry.”
“Are you sorry?”
A gangster’s courtship, interpreted as a threat by an ordinary person. Due to Pilsung’s rough speech and appearance, Wooyoon mistakenly believes him to be a loan shark who also deals in organ trafficking. He desperately tries to avoid Pilsung. Completely oblivious to this, Pilsung, believing a special connection exists between them, confesses his feelings and asks Wooyoon out.
“I’ve never seen anyone who looks like you. I can’t get you out of my head. It’s driving me crazy thinking about you, what the f*ck am I supposed to do?”
“…….”
“f*ck it, I’ll be a fool for you. I’ll be your sucker.”
“…….”
“I’ll protect you. I’ll find your brother.”
“…….”
“Go out with me.”
The tearful, unrequited love story of Baek Pilsung, transitioning from top gangster to lovesick fool!

108919.synopsis:
I possessed the body of a hopeless prince in a game, armed with a cheat.
But this cheat, it’s experiencing rank growth that wasn’t originally there.
[Insight into all items.] 
[Insight into all objects.] 
[Insight into all magic…] 
Wait a minute—this kingdom is supposed to fall apart right from the start?

110455.synopsis:
“Again! Again?! I’m seriously going to lose it.”
An elite A-rank hunter and team leader of a major guild.
But no matter how desperately he clings to life, he always ends up back in the spring of his twenty-fifth year. Over and over again.
After far too many regressions, F-rank hunter Kim Doyoon finally accepts the truth staring him in the face.
This world is stuck on repeat.
And—
This regression isn’t even for me.
He’s just a speck, caught in the current of something far bigger.
Now awakened to his 19th regression, Doyoon sets out to uncover the truth behind this chaotic loop—only to be approached out of the blue by S-rank hunter Yoo Seung-jae, who offers him a hand… and a spot on his team.
Everything’s lining up a little too perfectly, and yet—
Why does every fiber of his being scream that something is off?
* * *
“I came to pick you up.”
“…Why?”
“Because I said I would.”
Yoo Seung-jae looked straight at me, beaming like the damn sun itself. That kind of smile—blinding, sincere, like it was meant only for me.
And I—
Bang!
Shit.
I slammed the door in his face out of sheer panic.

112759.synopsis:
Ji Yuan transmigrated into a cultivation world.
Although he luckily became a cultivator, he ended up with the fate of being a fisherman for a cultivation sect.
With such a starting point, he thought he was most likely doomed to the path of “Don’t Bully the Poor Young Man,” only to remain poor in youth, middle age, and old age.
But unexpectedly, he awakened a Building Upgrade Panel.
【Fish Pond lv1: Fish fry growth speed +20%, semi-spiritual fish have a certain chance to evolve into spiritual fish】
【Cave Dwelling lv1: Self-healing walls, basic dust-repelling barrier, +20% spiritual energy concentration at night】
【Chicken Coop lv1: One spiritual egg produced daily, containing trace spiritual energy, can be used for fasting】
【Pigsty lv1: Spiritual pig gains 100 catties of muscle in seven days, its flesh contains body-tempering medicinal properties, and can accelerate wound healing】
【Spiritual Field lv1: Crop cycle -30%, produce contains trace wood-element spiritual energy】
【……】
From the most basic 【Fish Pond】 to the cultivation world’s 【Pill Refining Room】 and 【Weapon Refining Room】, as long as it was Ji Yuan’s building, all of them could be upgraded.
“Cultivation, cultivation—not about fighting and killing, but about seeking longevity and enduring existence.”
Many years later, when geniuses fell, sacred grounds decayed, and mighty ones perished,
only “Heavenly Venerable Ji” remained immortal, eternally flourishing through the ages.

120695.synopsis:
The Hero defeated the Demon Lord, and peace returned to the world.
But the Demon Lord wasn’t having it: “That hero totally cheated! I call foul!”Then—bam!—just like that, the terrifying Demon Lord, feared as the strongest being in the world… turned into the cutest magical girl on Earth.
Iros: “Wahaha! Bet you didn’t see this coming, s*upid Hero! I’m back, and this time I’ll crush you in style!”
Alicia: “Iros, want some cake?”
Iros: “Yes please! Alicia’s sweets are the best. I love you, Alicia!”
Evil God: “Pretty sure Alicia is the Hero, though.”
Iros, looking at the cake in her hands: “Nonsense! There’s no way the Hero could be a girl!”
associated_names: Lv998的魔王变成了魔法少女

121975.synopsis:
Have you ever seen a game where you start with a small campfire, surrounded by endless snowfields, you have to carry all resources by hand, and monsters attack at any time?
Xia Hong wakes up to find himself in exactly such a world.
Blizzards ravage the land, Frost Beasts dominate the earth, civilization is lost.
Everything and everyone from the past has been corrupted into powerful Abominations by the unknown.
Humanity has been reduced to a lowly race surviving under the shadow of eternal winter, on the brink of extinction.
Fortunately, Xia Hong possesses a Camp Upgrade System that can evolve endlessly:
【Small Campfire】→【Iron Furnace】→【Solar Cauldron】
【Wooden Stake】→【Martial Arts Training Ground】→【Dojo】
【Bamboo Fence】→【Black Earth Wall】→【Ironclad Wall】
【Marker Stone】→【Notice Board】→【Heroic Monument】
…
As Xia Hong slays frost beasts and abominations, gathers survivors, drives back the cold, and expands territory,
the secrets of this frozen world begin to unfold…
associated_names: 无尽寒冬：我的营地无限升级

123767.synopsis:
The genius Chinese medicine doctor Zhou Manman has crossed into the book and become a beautiful but brainless vicious female supporting role.
In the book, the original owner, an educated youth, went to the countryside to marry the disabled big man Gu Linchuan, and then she acted like a tyrant and died tragically. 
After crossing into the book, Zhou Manman was forced to bind the “intimate space”.
Looking at the handsome and heroic face of the male protagonist, eight abdominal muscles, and a strong body like a mountain.
Suddenly, she felt that it was not difficult to complete the strategy task.
When she met him for the first time, she couldn’t help hugging him and pinching his abdominal muscles.
When she met him for the second time, she couldn’t help kissing his lips.
She wanted to tear him apart and eat him all the time.
But the iceberg-like man was indifferent to her beauty plan.
When the space supplies became more and more, Zhou Manman cured Gu Linchuan’s leg and ran away.
As a result, not long after, she was caught by the abstinent and cold man. At this time, the man could not hide the desire in his eyes.
His dark eyes were fierce, he pushed her against the wall: “Manman, you’re going to run away after you’re done with me? I’ll have to deal with you.”
The next day, Zhou Manman held her waist and wanted to cry but had no tears.
Where is the cold-faced and abstinent man? Why is he so two-faced in front and behind people backs!
associated_names: 七零随军：娇娇知青带着空间暴富
七零随軍：嬌嬌知青帶着空間暴富

128119.synopsis:
Erika transmigrated into a girl with the same name in a parallel world. 
When the online game “Striving for Immortality” launched, she drew the one-in-a-billion three-red talents! 
Following the Dao of Nature! 
Boundless Blessings! 
Heavenly Guard Protection! 
From then on, Erika sprinted down the glorious path of evolving from a brute-force Daoist into an invincible Celestial Master! … 
“Why is her Divine Lightning so much thicker than the Heavenly Thunder!” 
“Why can she even use the Body of Heaven and Earth?” 
“Are you telling me this is a Celestial Master? 
How is she so different from the others?” 
“You… don’t come any closer!” 
The minds of many masters collapsed…
associated_names: 變身女天師，生死看淡，不服就干

130935.synopsis:
Three days after her husband went missing in the deep forest where a monster lives, he returned.
But… no matter how she looked at him, that person—no, that being—did not seem to be her husband.
***
The husband, who came in as a live-in son-in-law, revealed his true colors as soon as they married.
Though incompetent, he indulged in debauchery and deceived his wife, Griselda.
That husband returned, having been swapped with the monster of the deep forest.
The monster, hiding its identity, was kind, serious in everything, and whispered obedience to Griselda.
…Then, wouldn’t it be fine to make this monster into a husband that suits her taste?

131959.synopsis:
Zhu Ling had spent ten years in a psychiatric hospital.
Until one day, he was dragged into a bizarre and dangerous game.
The moment Zhu Ling’s livestream automatically started, viewers were greeted by a bewildered yet strikingly beautiful young man.
Not only was Zhu Ling’s appearance captivating, but he also exuded an air of fragile vulnerability that tugged at the heartstrings.
His player stats, clearly displayed on his panel, showed nothing but a row of utterly useless attributes.
Countless viewers sighed: What a shame, just a pretty face with no substance.
Some gleeful players even boldly predicted how he would meet his demise.
That was until they saw the ruthless NPCs hunting down other players—nurses who had cared for Zhu Ling for ten years, or the deranged NPCs conducting experiments on other players—who turned out to be Zhu Ling’s former attending physician…
Every NPC treated Zhu Ling with utmost care, a stark contrast to their cruel and merciless behavior toward other players.
In the first instance, players dismissed it as coincidence.
In the second instance, the boss was Zhu Ling’s former hospital roommate. In the third, the boss was his classmate…
It wasn’t until Zhu Ling flawlessly cleared instance after instance—without a single point added to his stats—that players gasped in realization:
Zhu Ling must be a self-aware NPC!
Exploiting the “acquaintance advantage” to cheese the game, huh?
Furious, players reported him to the system.
Zhu Ling flipped open his player panel with a scoff: “Acquaintance advantage?”
His SSS-tier stats blinded everyone in disbelief.

133239.synopsis:
I’ve been reincarnated as the maid of the villain destined to destroy half the empire before being defeated by the hero. Six years remain before his descent into darkness. 
“Young Master! You startled me. What are you doing awake at this hour?” 
“S-Sienna. It’s not…it’s just…in my dream, you…Ah, damn it.” 
As Sienna approached, the mana-infused lamp illuminated what Damon held in his hand. He quickly hid it behind his back, but Sienna had already seen everything. And what she saw…as far as she knew…belonged to Damon… 
“Why are you holding your undergarments in the middle of the night?”

[……A creature of the Turbellaria class, roughly a cousin of the planarian.] 
[Until Next Evolution] 
[1/10]

138615.synopsis:
Someone who leaves a vivid afterimage upon a single glance—
An actor whose allure goes far beyond mere good looks: Ki Siyoung.
For certain reasons, Seungun becomes his new manager.
> “I’ll be straightforward. If you’re here to build connections, turn around and leave.
I can’t stand people who talk to me for personal reasons.”
“Understood. I’m not much of a talker myself.”
The new road manager may seem polite and efficient—a pushover, even—
but he is by no means someone easy to deal with.
> “What did you say your name was?”
“I haven’t mentioned it yet.”
A type he’s never encountered before.
Unable to discern his true intentions, Ki Siyoung finds himself intrigued.
He begins to weigh his feelings between curiosity and affection—
for only time will tell which of the two runs deeper.

158327.synopsis:
I woke up as a slime in a strange forest teeming with monsters.
Romantic fantasy? No way. I was focused on carving out a survival fantasy and adapting, when…
A human fell into the forest.
With grimy but noble attire and a handsome face.
A troubled past and a kind, upright heart.
This is a complete fantasy protagonist!
If I stick close by, I might even secure a luxurious retirement in the human world.
My eyes lit up as I dreamed of a future as a companion monster.
I thought we had smoothly bonded and forged a comradely friendship while tumbling through hardships together.
—
Elijah snatched me away, pulling me out of someone else’s arms where I was quietly resting.
“You shouldn’t hold him like that.”
…? You hold me the same way.
 “He’s very shy. My slime likes my hands the best.”
Elijah’s beautiful eyes gently blocked my view.
“Right? You have no one but me.”
Was his character always like this?
associated_names: How to Survive as a Slime in This World

163703.synopsis:
I transmigrated and transformed into a beautiful girl. That part was nothing special.
But Ye Qian’s ability is a little… off.
She can replicate endlessly.
Like drawing from a gacha, more and more beautiful girl bodies of all kinds keep appearing—each one under her control.
Fight monsters, level up, farm gear, gain powerful strength, and reproduce even more girls.
Then those girls replicate more girls…
Lolis, girls, mature ladies, white stockings, black stockings…
There are too many! There’s no room left! (scratched out)
Can’t I just cuddle with myself?
Or perhaps let people experience the terror of being targeted by an organization of beautiful girls?
“However… my good buddy still doesn’t seem to know I’ve transformed. She even wants to pursue one of my clones.” 
Heh. Keep dreaming.
associated_names: 变身少女无限增殖，我的数量成灾了

176759.synopsis:
News of a marriage agreement between the Huo and An families spread, instantly causing a huge uproar across the city. Rumor had it that Huo Beixing was moody and unpredictable, with perverse tendencies and unusual fetishes.
Some people said that once An Yi went there, he would just be played with until he died. Others sighed in admiration at An Yi’s courage, saying he truly feared nothing.
An Yi said, “I’m scared to death, okay :)”
